messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: HIGH severity alert for region eu-west-1 — elevated 5xx and latency observed on Hosted API and several Dedicated pools. Paging on-call SRE Marcos.

Marcos: Acknowledged. Pulling dashboards now. Seeing spike in ELB 5xxs and auth/backplane egress errors in eu-west-1. Hosted API p95 from ~120ms -> ~850-950ms, 5xx ~5-7% over last 5m. Several Dedicated pools showing connection resets and long queues.

Marcos: Quick trace sample shows backend waits on STS/KMS and our auth broker. Retries to upstream seem to coincide with the errors. Opening this incident channel.

Ana: I can handle routing/fallback. Are auth calls sync on the hot path? If so we should avoid making any new synchronous STS calls when upstream is flapping.

Marcos: They are synchronous today. Short patch to change that would take >30m. Proposed mitigations: 1) enable cross-region session creation fallback (prefer eu-west-2) for new requests; 2) increase route timeouts to avoid client 5xx noise; 3) admission-control for non-critical workloads in affected region.

Suresh: Confirmed via cloud telemetry — elevated 5xx egress to STS endpoints and some ELB target health flapping in eu-west-1. Opening an AWS support case and escalating.

Marcos: Action items: Suresh escalate AWS and paste ticket; Ana prepare router policy flip; Lena gather impacted-customer list and coordinate CS outreach; I'll draft initial status page.

Lena: Priya (CS) is on standby. Initial impacted list: two Dedicated reserved customers in eu-west-1, three high-traffic Hosted customers with heavy auth flows. Priya will pre-draft communications.

Ana: Routing change ready for dry-run. Plan: prefer eu-west-2 for new session allocations when eu-west-1 health < threshold. Preserve existing sticky sessions to avoid breaking in-flight requests. Dry-run + apply commands below.

``` 
# dry-run
curl -s -X POST "https://router.internal/api/v1/policy" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"region_preference": ["eu-west-2","eu-central-1"], "fallback_on_errors": true, "dry_run": true }'

# apply
curl -s -X POST "https://router.internal/api/v1/policy" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"region_preference": ["eu-west-2","eu-central-1"], "fallback_on_errors": true }'
```

Marcos: Also increasing hosted-api route timeout from 5s -> 12s to reduce surface 5xxs while upstream heals. Ana: coordinate so Dedicated autoscaling doesn't thrash.

Ana: Dry-run shows session creation shift as expected (eu-west-1 down ~75% new sessions, eu-west-2 up ~80%). Applying policy now. Monitoring for auth token/credential issues. :white_check_mark:

status-page-bot: STATUS PAGE DRAFT — "We are investigating elevated latency and error rates in eu-west-1 impacting API calls. We have enabled cross-region fallback for new traffic and are working with our cloud provider to resolve the underlying issue. Some Dedicated customers in eu-west-1 may experience degraded throughput. We will provide updates every 30 minutes." Posting now.

Priya: Sending targeted notices to the two Reserved Dedicated customers. Advising immediate cross-region redirection or accepting temporary eu-west-2 handling. Scheduling support calls as requested.

Marcos: Observability note: traces show many requests blocked waiting on STS/KMS calls which returned 502/504 from provider. Our internal retries (short backoff) amplified load across the control plane. We've applied a conservative retry strategy (exp backoff + jitter) to reduce synchronized retry storms.

Suresh: For Dedicated pools we can spin temporary capacity in eu-west-2 and reassign reserved mappings. Kicking off a scale job to provision extra instances and attach to affected pool IDs.

Marcos: Admission control applied to reduce amplification: drop low-priority/queued batch jobs and limit max tokens per request temporarily.

```
# admission-control
curl -s -X POST "https://platform.internal/api/v1/admission" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADM_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"drop_low_priority": true, "max_tokens": 1024, "duration_minutes": 30}'
```

Lena: Public status posted. CS outreach dispatched to top affected customers. Preparing private incident summary for enterprise stakeholders (execs/legal/compliance).

Ana: Metrics 15 minutes after mitigation: Hosted API p95 back to ~140ms global; eu-west-1 still has tail errors for pinned sessions (~0.5-1%). New session creation shifted to eu-west-2 successfully. Dedicated migration ongoing; currently ~60% migrated with ETA ~20-30m for remaining pinned sessions.

Suresh: AWS case update: they confirm regional egress/control-plane instability in eu-west-1 and are applying fixes. ETA unclear but they estimate partial restoration within 45-90 minutes. I'll paste updates from AWS here.

Marcos: Handoff to Ana for long-running mitigation and RCA. Handoff summary: cause = upstream cloud egress/control-plane errors -> STS/KMS/auth broker failures -> increased latency/5xx. Actions done = cross-region fallback, increased timeouts, admission-control, spun temporary Dedicated capacity, CS notified, AWS escalated. Open = finish Dedicated migrations, monitor AWS ticket, prepare full postmortem.

Ana: Taking ownership. I'll manage remaining migrations and start the RCA doc. Please DM if you have outstanding tasks.

Marcos: Leaving oncall — will rejoin the RCA. If there is regression, call the incident bridge. Great work team.

status-page-bot: UPDATE — "Mitigations have reduced user impact. We are monitoring and will share further updates as AWS provides additional information."
